title: OM System OM-5 Mark II Rugged Outdoor Camera
purpose: All-weather outdoor wilderness expedition, environmental landscape, and macro photography featuring IP53 splashproof sealing, 7.5-stop Sync IS, 50MP handheld high-resolution shot, and deep Micro Four Thirds depth of field.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: OM System OM-5 Mark II (20.0MP Micro Four Thirds Live MOS)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 20.0MP Micro Four Thirds Live MOS sensor with TruePic IX processor (50MP Handheld High-Res Mode)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_dimensions: 17.4x13.0mm Micro Four Thirds sensor (2.0x crop factor)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 24-80mm equivalent professional standard zoom field of view
sensor_and_optics.lens: M.Zuiko Digital ED 12-40mm f/2.8 PRO II (24-80mm FF equivalent, IP53 weather sealed)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13.0 stops dynamic range (expanded with computational Live ND16 and Handheld High-Res)
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane mechanical shutter to 1/8000s, electronic shutter to 1/32,000s, 7.5-stop Sync IS

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Rugged outdoor atmospheric weather: rainforest mist, mountain fog, raking alpine sunrise, or rainy wilderness daylight
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Rich earthy greens and foliage tones, natural shadow density, computational highlight retention with Live ND16 motion smoothing

surface_rendering: Intense botanical and geological micro-texture: moss filaments, damp granite stone, water droplets on foliage, and bark striations
Immense resolving authority in 50MP Handheld High-Res mode with zero motion jitter due to 7.5-stop Sync IS
Vibrant, true-to-life nature color science with organic foliage tones and atmospheric moisture rendition
depth_and_optics: Deep inherent Micro Four Thirds depth of field, maintaining sharp foreground foliage to distant mountain ridges at f/4.0-f/5.6 without diffraction softening
Exceptional close-focus magnification with crisp edge acutance across the entire frame
Rugged eye-level or low-angle ground perspective capturing immersive wilderness scale

execution_directive: Enforce 20MP Micro Four Thirds outdoor expedition capture, deep environmental depth of field, razor-sharp botanical and rock textures, atmospheric moisture, and natural earthy tones, shot on OM System OM-5 Mark II.
